import openpyxl

input_path = sys.argv[1]
output_path = sys.argv[2]

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
ws = wb["Sheet2"]

# Fiscal month selector is in D7; months are in G3:R3
# For each summary row, look up the corresponding data row for the fiscal month.
ws["D9"] = "=INDEX(G4:R4,1,MATCH($D$7,$G$3:$R$3,0))"
ws["D10"] = "=INDEX(G5:R5,1,MATCH($D$7,$G$3:$R$3,0))"
ws["D11"] = "=INDEX(G6:R6,1,MATCH($D$7,$G$3:$R$3,0))"
ws["D12"] = "=INDEX(G7:R7,1,MATCH($D$7,$G$3:$R$3,0))"

wb.save(output_path)
print("saved", output_path)", "path": "/bench/answers/56274/solution.py"}, "name": "write"}
